approvers: Own decision; site manager and main contractor's coating specs
reason: We spend about 5,000 a year on film and board at 12 a m2 with our own labour, and this is 19 a m2 plus a 150 m2 minimum and a 50% deposit. Film works and I know what it does to coated glass; a coating is a new risk for me.
objection: Almost 60% dearer than what we do now, deposit up front when I pay suppliers at 60 to 90 days, and I do not know what a sprayed coating does to coated glass and frame finishes when it comes off.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film and board with tape, applied and removed by our own people.
would_change_my_mind: A test panel on our own coated glass and frames that peels clean with no marks, at or near 12 to 14 a m2 all-in, with no deposit and 60-day terms, plus a Maltese contractor reference.
